preview: This episode explores what makes an office feel workable when employees do not all want the same kind of place to work. By the end, you will understand why a desk arrangement can matter in ways that are not obvious at first.
comment_1: As you listen, notice the different reactions and what may explain them.
comment_2: Now, you will hear two different voices, one after the other. Each person will describe the office from their own point of view.
comment_3: You have heard two people talk about the same office in different ways. Instead of asking which view is right, let us ask why the experience feels different to each person. Next, we will look more closely at where that difference comes from.
comment_4: So the question is not only who is right. We can also ask what is making the same situation feel stable for one person and difficult for another. That takes us one step deeper.
